title: Add Structured Request Logging with Correlation IDs
description: Introduce a lightweight logging middleware that emits structured JSON logs for each request, including a unique correlation ID, request method, URL, status, response time, and client IP. This improves observability, aids debugging in production, and enables easy correlation across distributed services.
testCases: Logs contain a correlationId that matches the value set on req.correlationId
JSON log includes method, url, status, responseTime, and clientIp fields
Middleware does not alter response body or status code
acceptance: When the server receives a request, a JSON log entry is written to stdout with all required fields, a unique correlationId is attached to the request object, and the original response behavior remains unchanged.
reason: Enhanced observability is critical for production stability; structured logs and correlation IDs enable rapid issue triage, performance monitoring, and seamless integration with log aggregation platforms, directly supporting the framework's stability-focused roadmap.
